author: Elpos
quote: A game you wait for for years, and it keeps getting delayed. When it finally comes out, what a disaster! A truly awful game, and the worst part is that it was the most anticipated game, but when it finally arrived, it was incredibly disappointing. It's just a walk-and-shoot, boring gameplay, romantic relationships that feel like a family and marriage simulation, and incredibly disgusting and inappropriate scenes for both children and adults. Not to mention the technical errors in the game, as if it hadn't been delayed for so long. There's no autosave. It doesn't deserve any praise.
